newsitem.title: THAILAND: Married orangutan delivers baby in Thai zoo.
newsitem.headline: Married orangutan delivers baby in Thai zoo.

text.p: Thailand's only married orangutan couple are now the happy parents of a male baby ape.

Zuzu, an eight-year old orangutan who made headlines last year when she was flown from Taiwan to marry Mike -- a lonely ape who needed a mate -- in an elaborate traditional ceremony, gave birth to a 1.1 kg (2.42 lb) baby late on Tuesday night.
The delivery, expected for weeks, took place at Lopburi zoo, 120 km (70 miles) north of Bangkok.
Hundreds of people have flocked to the zoo, Thailand's oldest, over the past few weeks with the hope of seeing Zuzu give birth.
"We had champagne and a big celebration last night," said Dr Kurpih Pei, a Taiwanese who exported Zuzu to Thailand and came to look after her during her delivery.
